messages:
Sam: quick thread from support: a customer exported CSV and got raw vectors despite the checkbox being unchecked. can we make the opt-in flow stronger?
Alex: agreed. propose: default to EXCLUDE vectors, move "Include raw vectors" into an Advanced section with a visible short warning + required "I understand" checkbox before download.
Priya: a11y: link the warning via aria-describedby to the checkbox and make the confirm required with aria-invalid if unchecked on submit. also ensure keyboard users can open Advanced via Enter/Space.
Nora: CSV ordering: export should reflect the visible columns in the preview (exclude controls). add a small toggle in modal: "Export visible columns only" (on if user has hidden columns). update CSV header order accordingly.
Diego: accessibility nits: screen readers hear score twice because we left SR helper and visible pill readable. pattern: keep SR-only "Relevance: 0.87" and set visual pill aria-hidden="true". also add a polite aria-live announcer for bulk selections (debounced ~200ms) that says "X items selected".
Sam: copy suggestions: advanced warning = "Warning: exporting raw vectors may expose sensitive information. Only export with permission." dense toggle tooltip = "Dense preview (opt-in) — show more rows per page; may affect keyboard nav and performance."
Alex: product: add persistent density preference in user settings and a keyboard shortcut hint in the tooltip (Shortcut: D). track include_vectors usage in telemetry and audit logs.
Priya: UI checklist for engineers: 1) default exclude vectors, 2) Advanced accordion with required confirm, 3) aria-describedby on include checkbox, 4) export-visible-columns option, 5) fix SR duplicate reads, 6) aria-live for multi-select, 7) contrast check for score pill.
Nora: I'll update Figma components with the warning text, export checkbox copy, dense toggle token and contrast options. please review before PR.
Diego: I'll implement CSV-by-view mapping + aria changes and add unit tests. will tag QA for a quick smoke test once staged.
Sam: thanks. QA: please attach the problematic CSV to the bug. we'll prioritize the export confirm flow this sprint.
